text: The largest behaviour changes this week touch billing and platform features. #12207 marks MCP Data Query Tools as billable and requires a pricing acknowledgement before activation, with headless imports defaulting to disabled. #12428 adds a public Copilot feature trial interface to System Application. #12242 opens Power BI report deployment to all companies, not only evaluation ones, and #12064 lets the SharePoint connector handle hash and percent characters in paths. #9953 renames AppSource text to Marketplace. Finance and localization fixes include #11629 for Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 export, #11848 for foreign currency opening balances in report 11564, #12127 for the Austrian U30 form, #9347 for German IssueDate, #12141 for non-deductible VAT on foreign-currency projects and #12135 for the Reverse Charge VAT upgrade. E-documents gain Peppol export of self-billed purchase documents in #11560, while #12055 now shows an error for unmatched Order Responses. Manufacturing fixes cover #11959, #12188, #12059 and #11994. Subscription Billing fixes are #10446, #10182 and #11637. Shopify received #11604, #12215, #12214, #12260 and #12139. Cleanup includes CLEAN27 removal in #12290 and #12293, and performance work in #12078 and #12307. BCQuality added knowledge articles, among them #214, #208 and #177.
